title: Billing: plan, Checkout, Customer Portal, invoices
caption: PF-71 to PF-75. Owners act, finance reads; Checkout needs FEATURE_STRIPE_BILLING and Stripe test values.

steps.title: Read the subscription
steps.expect: Plan name, status, "Free trial, no payment details needed" for a manual trial, trial end and period end in the OTA's time zone.

steps.title: Choose a plan
steps.body: Pick a plan (Annual billing switch), **Continue to payment**.
steps.expect: Stripe Checkout opens (URL only from the API, https only); cancel → `?checkout=canceled` neutral notice.

steps.title: Pay
steps.body: Test card 4242 4242 4242 4242 in Stripe test mode.
steps.expect: Back via `/setup?checkout=success` → `/billing?checkout=success`: "Confirming your payment" until the webhook made the subscription `trialing`/`active`, then "Payment confirmed".

steps.title: Manage in Stripe
steps.expect: 303 to Stripe's Customer Portal; return URL is the billing page. Without a Stripe customer: "choose a plan first".

steps.title: Invoices
steps.expect: Newest first, totals with `Money` (`5000 JPY` → ¥5,000), View/Download PDF only for https links; drafts "Not available yet".
